description: This file defines models, types, constants, and interfaces related to popover components in an Angular project, including animation triggers, placement options, and configuration interfaces.

methods.name: isStrictPopoverPlacement
methods.description: Checks if a given placement string is a strict popover placement.

methods.name: convertStrictPopoverPlacement
methods.description: Converts a strict popover placement to a general popover placement by removing the 'Only' suffix.

methods.name: getPlacementName
methods.description: Determines the placement name based on overlay position connection pair.
